videoTitle: WEIRD: The Al Yankovic Story - official trailer

comments.author: @trollbewonkenobi8030
comments.text: I love the fact that Al himself is in it, but in the most straight, normal, and un-Weird role possible.

comments.author: @grabble7605
comments.text:
"Your father and I think it would be best if you...Stop being who you are and doing what you love."
This is gonna be a great movie.

comments.author: @hotelmario510
comments.text: I love that this trailer contains every "musical biopic" cliché you could possibly want. It's just like Weird Al to have a biopic made about his life that parodies biopics.

comments.author: @charlesmurphy3222
comments.text: The first mockumentary when the subject matter lampoons himself at his expense. Pure genius.

comments.author: @HYTTFilms
comments.text: I like how Weird Al did a parody of his own life in this biopic. He's finally gone full circle.

comments.author: @famijher
comments.text: Yay! Al has made a totally factual biopic about his life. He would never put a bunch of stuff in there to make fun of biopics. Not him, never him. He's way to serious to do something like that.

comments.author: @alphabetbeer
comments.text: The part where Radcliffe opens his mouth but Weird Al's voice came out had me in stitches

comments.author: @SomeYouTubeTraveler
comments.text:
“When my last movie UHF came out in 1989, I made a solemn vow to my fans that I would release a major motion picture every 33 years, like clockwork. I’m very happy to say we’re on schedule. And I am absolutely thrilled that Daniel Radcliffe will be portraying me in the film. I have no doubt whatsoever that this is the role future generations will remember him for.”

-Weird Al

comments.author: @thecasualfriday8770
comments.text: The fact that they just did a voice-over of Al's singing voice instead of having Radcliff attempt it or do an audio mix of the two voices (like they did in bohemian rhapsody) is hilarious. It reminds me of English dubbed animes where whenever a character has to sing something, they just cut to the original japanese audio so they don't have to localize a whole song or make the VA sing in Japanese.

comments.text: 2:37 i love that the guy at the desk is played by the real Al Yankovic!!
